title.narrative: Pacific E-Mobility Projects under GEF8

description.narrative: The project supports faster uptake of EVs and sustainable mobility in general, including a combination of several of the following components: i)Strengthening Institutional arrangements and Coordination, Strategies, Policies, and regulatory framework; ii) Pilots in identified priority e-vehicle categories and Charging; iii) Business Models, Financing Mechanism to Accelerate uptake; iv) Environmental friendly management of Battery re-use and re-cycling; and v) Capacity Building and Awareness Raising. Applicable SOs to be determined once the project concept is prepared
